season.name: Summer
season.line: Labor without Sabbath becomes bondage, however fruitful it looks.

movement.name: The Rest
movement.line: A people who cannot stop are not free.

days.t: Come to me, all who labor
x: Come to Me, all those toiling and burdened, and I will give you⁺ rest.
Take up My yoke upon you⁺ and learn from Me, because I am gentle and humble [in] heart, and you⁺ will find rest [for] your⁺ souls.
For My yoke [is] easy and My burden is light.”

days.t: The Lord tends me as a shepherd
x: A Psalm of David. The Lord tends me as a shepherd, and I shall want nothing.
In a place of green grass, there he has made me dwell: he has nourished me by the water of rest.
He has restored my soul: he has guided me into the paths of righteousness, for his name's sake.

days.t: He gives to his beloved sleep
x: It is vain for you to rise early: ye rise up after resting, ye that eat the bread of grief; while he gives sleep to his beloved.

days.t: In peace I will lie down and sleep
x: I will both lie down in peace and sleep: for thou, Lord, only hast caused me to dwell securely.

days.t: Come away by yourselves and rest
x: And He said to them, “Come, you⁺ yourselves, apart to a wilderness place, and rest a little.” For those coming and those going were many, and not even were they having opportunity to eat.

days.t: My peace I give to you
x: Peace I leave with you⁺; My peace I give to you⁺. Not as the world gives do I give to you⁺. Let not your⁺ heart be troubled, nor let it be afraid.
